title: Sales → Engineering Handoff System
excerpt: A structured handoff model for moving project-critical information from sales into engineering without relying on memory or repeated clarification.

sections.heading: The problem
paragraphs: Sales had context that engineering did not. Information lived across calls, messages, proposals and memory, so engineering often had to reconstruct the actual scope after a customer had already committed.

sections.heading: What changed
paragraphs: The handoff was treated as a defined operational step rather than an informal email. Required information, ownership and exception handling were made explicit.
sections.imageAlt: Process map showing sales, handoff, engineering and delivery

sections.heading: The principle
paragraphs: Automation can accelerate a structured process. It cannot repair missing inputs, ambiguous ownership or an undefined handoff.
